structure_explanation.en: The target structure is 〜てもらえない: take a verb in the te-form (貸して, 'to lend') and add もらえない, the negative potential form of もらう ('to receive a favor'). Literally it is 'can't I receive the favor of you lending?', but it functions as a polite, gentle request: 'could you possibly lend me?'. The negative in question form makes the request less direct and more courteous. 30ドル ('30 dollars') is the object of the loan.

A forma negativa em pergunta deixa o pedido menos direto e mais cortês. 30ドル ('30 dólares') é o objeto do empréstimo.
